items.name: pane-style
items.title: Style
items.description: Base style for Pane. Installs the shared dependencies and the --pane-* design tokens — blur, saturation, tint, border, highlight and shadow — for light and dark.
items.author: Deniz Isik (https://github.com/deniiiiz-i)

items.name: utils
items.title: Utils
items.description: The cn helper — clsx merged through tailwind-merge. Every Pane component imports it.
items.author: Deniz Isik (https://github.com/deniiiiz-i)

items.name: glass-core
items.title: Glass Core
items.description: The glass engine behind every surface: the displacement-map generator that bends the backdrop at the rim, the SVG refraction filter, the tuning config for both variants, and the shared CVA variants.
items.author: Deniz Isik (https://github.com/deniiiiz-i)

items.name: use-glass-pointer
items.title: Glass Pointer
items.description: Tracks the pointer and the surface's position in the viewport, then writes the specular lighting inputs straight to the node as CSS custom properties — spring-smoothed, and without costing a React render.
items.author: Deniz Isik (https://github.com/deniiiiz-i)

items.name: use-glass-support
items.title: Glass Support
items.description: Detects how much of the glass material the browser can actually render and honors prefers-reduced-transparency, so surfaces degrade to blur or to a flat tint instead of breaking.
items.author: Deniz Isik (https://github.com/deniiiiz-i)

items.name: pane
items.title: Pane
items.description: The glass primitive every other component is built on — a refracted rim, a tinted backdrop, and a specular highlight that follows the pointer. Ships regular and clear variants, and flattens automatically when nested.
items.author: Deniz Isik (https://github.com/deniiiiz-i)

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: A glass button in default and destructive variants across four sizes, with asChild support via Radix Slot.
items.author: Deniz Isik (https://github.com/deniiiiz-i)

items.name: card
items.title: Card
items.description: A glass card with header, title, description, action, content and footer parts.
items.author: Deniz Isik (https://github.com/deniiiiz-i)

items.name: badge
items.title: Badge
items.description: A compact glass badge in default and tinted variants, with asChild support for linking.
items.author: Deniz Isik (https://github.com/deniiiiz-i)

items.name: input
items.title: Input
items.description: A text input on a clear glass surface that raises a highlight ring on focus and dims when disabled.
items.author: Deniz Isik (https://github.com/deniiiiz-i)

items.name: switch
items.title: Switch
items.description: A Radix switch whose thumb is a glass pane, moved by a spring rather than a CSS transition.
items.author: Deniz Isik (https://github.com/deniiiiz-i)

items.name: tabs
items.title: Tabs
items.description: Radix tabs on a glass list, with a pane indicator that animates between triggers.
items.author: Deniz Isik (https://github.com/deniiiiz-i)

items.name: tooltip
items.title: Tooltip
items.description: A Radix tooltip rendered as a small glass pane, with provider, trigger and content parts.
items.author: Deniz Isik (https://github.com/deniiiiz-i)

items.name: dialog
items.title: Dialog
items.description: A Radix dialog whose panel is a glass pane over a blurred overlay, with header, footer, title and description parts.
items.author: Deniz Isik (https://github.com/deniiiiz-i)

items.name: sheet
items.title: Sheet
items.description: A Radix sheet that slides in from any of the four sides as a floating, inset glass panel.
items.author: Deniz Isik (https://github.com/deniiiiz-i)
